app_fee.value: The Graduate School application fee is $80 for international applicants (nonrefundable).

also.quote: Are application fees refundable? | Application fees are non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School fee waivers go to U.S. citizens and permanent residents in listed programs; international applicants must ask the department, and some departments offer a few waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School offers application fee waivers to U.S. citizens and permanent residents who are participants in the following programs only:

also.quote: You may also contact the department directly to ask whether they have fee waivers.

gre_general.value: Set by each department; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 for most programs; some departments (e.g. Chemistry, Math, Electrical and Computer Engineering) require 91 to 100.
toefl_min.quote: All Programs EXCEPT those listed below. 4.0 80 6.5 115 58 180

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 for most programs; some departments require 7.0 to 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: All Programs EXCEPT those listed below. 4.0 80 6.5 115 58 180

english_waiver.value: Citizens of India are on the exempt-country list, and study of a year or more at an institution in a listed country ending within two years also waives the test. Medium-of-instruction letters are not accepted. Engineering Management is the exception for India.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of English proficiency is NOT required if: | You are a citizen of a qualifying country | Grenada Guyana India** Ireland Jamaica | ** Applicants from India to the Engineering Management program must submit English Proficiency Scores. | Medium of Instruction (MOI) letters are NOT accepted and DO NOT meet the English proficiency requirement.

notes: Departments set their own English minimums in the Graduate School table (higher for Chemistry, Math, ECEE, Chemical and Biological Engineering, Biochemistry, MCDB).
